guidance: No loss coefficients are invented in this round. Only the propagation-loss experiment convention is listed as a known parameter; bend / crossing / interlayer losses are unknown and uncalibrated, and no total-loss conclusion is produced.

propagation_loss.source: fslw.config experiment convention (not a measured value)
propagation_loss.note: length-only experiment convention; not a measured glass value

bend_loss.note: no calibrated glass bend-loss function; R=15 mm is a geometry constraint only

crossing_loss.note: single-layer crossing optical feasibility not confirmed; crossing counts are geometric only

interlayer_loss.note: multi-layer transitions and interlayer propagation effects are not calibrated

total_loss_conclusion.reason: bend, crossing and interlayer coefficients are all unknown_uncalibrated; a total-loss number would require invented coefficients, so none is reported

layer_heights_unconfirmed.note: L2-L5 heights are exploratory simulation inputs, not confirmed process values; this also blocks formal process acceptance

geometric_inputs_only.note: lengths / arc counts / transition counts / crossing counts are reported as geometric inputs only and are deliberately NOT converted into total loss
